+TEST_CASE("[FontVariation] Set and get properties") {
+	Ref<FontVariation> fv;
+	fv.instantiate();
+
+	fv->set_variation_embolden(0.5f);
+	CHECK(fv->get_variation_embolden() == doctest::Approx(0.5f));
+

+	CHECK(fv->get_variation_face_index() == 3);
